title: Ship a command palette
description: A three-turn product demo: inspect the app, build a command palette, then add keyboard navigation.

turns.prompt: Take a look at this app. I want to add a command palette so users can jump to any page.

events.text: I’ll check the app’s navigation and components, then add a command palette that fits the existing UI.

The app has four pages and a shared navigation list. I’ll use that list to keep the palette in sync.

The palette will open with **⌘K**, filter as you type, and close with Escape.

turns.prompt: Go ahead. Keep it small and make it feel native to the app.

events.text: I’m adding the palette as a small component and connecting the global keyboard shortcut.

events.name: apply_patch
